overview: You saw the cue go onto the public roll as a mark, and not as words said into the room. Thursday's margin is still there, and still dry. The deposition is not in this roll. The book and both rolls take the same mark. The chest stays shut.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Saw the cue entered, and left the cut where it was.

parties.name: Humphrey Larkham
parties.context: Marked the book and both rolls, signed the corner, and did not open the chest.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Marked the cue on the public roll

summary: Marked the cue on the public roll
